notablePrerequisites: You are able to defeat Invasion of Alara.
easyPrerequisites: You control at least one creature.
description:
Defeat Invasion of Alara, triggering it, causing you to exile it and cast Awaken the Maelstrom.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Awaken the Maelstrom, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Awaken the Maelstrom, causing a player to draw two cards, then allowing you to put an artifact card from your hand onto the battlefield, then creating a token copy of Naru Meha, then putting three +1/+1 counters on creature(s) you control, and then destroying a permanent an opponent controls.
Put either Naru Meha into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.name: Invasion of Alara // Awaken the Maelstrom
